text: The test kind selects comm_taskgraph.loader.test. Its loader finds builds by platform/type, rejects duplicate build keys, skips missing platforms and raises for unknown test sets. It creates per-platform test descriptions and yields them to transforms. The original local clone had five loader arguments; accepted code later forwards write_artifacts too. The computed signing map is not consumed by get_test_platforms in this source. These are generator contracts, not a successful decision-task run or proof every signing dependency resolves. No taskgraph or build ran.
